{ type: ComboboxFilterType; listbox: SingleSelectValue | MultiSelectValue | null; input?: string | null; }

Emitted when a listbox item is selected, when an input value is entered, and when the combobox is reset. Subscribe to provide your own filter function when this event is emitted. Emits { type: 'selection' | 'input' | 'reset'; listbox: string; input: string } where type is the type of filter event, listbox is the value of the selected item(s), and input is the value of the input.
